units.source_text: 就这样，囤水装置的研究，增加了他每天新的活动。

en.t: In this way, the study of the water storage device added a new activity to his daily routine.

units.source_text: 埋桶的位置……桶的形状……日照时间和囤水速度的关系……

en.t: The position of the buried bucket... the shape of the bucket... the relationship between hours of sunlight and the speed of water storage...

units.source_text: 气温和气压对效率的影响……数字和图形的记录，他都一一仔细地积累起来。

en.t: The effects of temperature and air pressure on efficiency... records of numbers and diagrams... he carefully accumulated them one by one.

units.source_text: 而女人一点也搞不懂，男人对套乌鸦的陷阱为什么会如此热衷。

en.t: But the woman could not understand at all why the man was so absorbed in a trap for catching crows.

units.source_text: 她相信，男人得有一样东西来摆弄，否则就过不去，假如这真能使他气顺，又未尝不可呢。

en.t: She believed that the man had to have something to tinker with or he could not get by, and if it really put him at ease, then there was nothing wrong with that.

units.source_text: 不知为什么，男人对女人的家庭手工活，也开始表现出积极的态度。

en.t: For some reason, the man also began to show a positive attitude toward the woman's household handiwork.
He was not in a bad mood.

units.source_text: 乌鸦陷阱之类的，即使打折扣，也还能找回绰绰有余的零钱。

en.t: As for things like the crow trap, even at a discount, it could still bring back more than enough change.

units.source_text: 可是，男人也充分准备了恰当的计算和动机。

en.t: But the man had also prepared proper calculations and motives in full.

units.source_text: 研究囤水装置也需要多种条件的组合，意外地费时。

en.t: Studying the water storage device also required combinations of many conditions, and it took more time than expected.

units.source_text: 资料的数量增加了，却找不到将这些资料统一起来的法则。

en.t: The amount of data increased, but he could not find a rule that would bring it all together.

units.source_text: 而且，要想得到正确的资料，无论如何需要一台收音机，需要掌握天气预报和概况。

en.t: Moreover, to obtain accurate data, he needed a radio no matter what, and he needed to keep track of the weather forecast and general conditions.

units.source_text: 于是，收音机成了两人共同的目标。

en.t: And so the radio became a shared goal for the two of them.
